outcome: AUDIT COMPLETE; targeted improvements recommended, no blanket regeneration
scope: All11 active articles,22 image placements; contact-sheet triage plus flagged reading-size images. No generation, source edits or browser bypass.
collection_findings: The shared gouache/charcoal texture and ochre/indigo palette create continuity but also a recognizable filter. Empty chairs, scripts/reels, warm domestic corners and picturesque rural horizons recur. Future targeted revisions should vary action and viewpoint rather than globally restyle everything.

Eight older heroes have no explicit skill/mode evidence in their current illustration provenance. This audit applies the skill now; it cannot establish that the skill was followed at creation. Do not backfill historical mode as verified.
Conceptual labels prevent an archival claim, but labels do not make every composition equally useful. Nandita montage and Sadhu generic scene are the clearest art-direction candidates.

Current documentary images should retain natural uneven light, crowd backgrounds, colour casts and original cropping disclosures. No reason found to generate over real faces or institutional photographs.
Sabyasachi and Babushaan photos are each reused twice, reasonably connecting profiles/films to flagship. Repetition is transparent, not evidence of different events.
The collection lacks a verified Manmohan portrait and actual licensed film stills. Context photos, a stamp and a novel page must not be represented as film frames.

mode_review.prospective_art_direction: Editorial Natural for most explanatory covers; Poetic Natural may fit Maya/Manmohan metaphor. These are recommendations for any future work, not retrospective mode certifications. Documentary photographs are preserved source records, not generated Documentary Natural evidence.

article_recommendations.reason: Drum/cloth is a specific readable livelihood motif; imagined reel-shadow must remain illustration, not documentation of an actual instrument or performance.
Layered empty rooms support household change without inventing identifiable characters or a film still. Warm interior repeats elsewhere but is justified here.
Book/pencil/reel directly convey adaptation and writing. Props are metaphorical, not her possessions; documentary stamp and novel page add specific evidence.

Empty chair, velvet curtain, spotlight and invented architectural backdrops are generic cinema symbolism; comparatively weak for an actor-centred profile. Simplify scene or use credited portrait as primary visual; preserve Padma photograph.

Rural frame fits observation and land pressure, but could read as a film still without label. FTII exterior is context, not portrait or his film set. A verified portrait or licensed still remains a worthwhile gap; do not fabricate it.

Floating papers, map-like wall, two city views, chair and camera make every surface narratively useful. This is an overfilled symbolic montage, not natural observed space. Stronger future version should choose one boundary-crossing action/metaphor and remove implied map/location specificity. Current explicit imagined-montage caption correctly limits claims.

Projector beam is clear metaphor but picturesque courtyard/temple/coast compress broad modern cinema into a tourist-like rural idyll. Future version should convey varied working/story worlds without invented identifying landmarks; not a reason to replace documentary photos.

Bag/film strip/road connects medicine, travel and cinema. Perfect winding route, sunset and picturesque remoteness soften the article’s hard access issues and foreground the lone doctor symbol. Future art pass could use more ordinary shared infrastructure/work context without depicting invented residents or a rescue scene.
Microphone/scripts make radio work legible. Generic imagined studio must not be dated1948. Original2013 building photograph retains its warm cast; do not polish it into imagined historical evidence.
CRT domestic viewing clearly differs from cinema venue; furnished room is somewhat curated but coherent editorial artwork. Not an actual programme, home or historical reconstruction.

Human viewer and phone distinguish contemporary use; plausible grip/posture and visible cable. Screen scene echoes outside landscape, so retain invented-content/no-specific-place scope rather than identify it as a film or location.

rights_reconciliation: Read Anvesha cinema-series-image-rights-audit-2026-10-25.json:11 documentary placements/9 unique assets, retained provenance. Visual appearance does not independently establish photographer identity or copyright clearance.
limits: Contact sheets are triage, not full-resolution cultural verification of every image. Five flagged heroes viewed full-size this pass; TV/OTT viewed full-size in preceding independent reviews.
No exact real location, prop authenticity, film-scene match or historic wardrobe is inferred from generated art.
No photographic adaptation/restoration substituted; earlier Nirad wash sample is not among current active placements.
No browser-rendered layout QA, new upstream rights clearance, human approval or sitewide compliance assertion.
